title: New Study Shows Tai Chi Helps People with Body Pain
subtitle: Large research project confirms that traditional Chinese exercises improve health for millions worldwide.

summary.en: A massive new study has confirmed that traditional Chinese exercises like Tai Chi provide significant health benefits. Researchers looked at data from over 1,700 clinical trials to reach their conclusions. The exercises help people suffering from musculoskeletal conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people globally. Benefits include better movement, improved sleep, and stronger bones. Experts suggest these exercises should be included in standard medical care worldwide.
summary.zh: 一項大規模的新研究證實，太極拳等傳統中國運動能帶來顯著的健康益處。研究人員分析了超過一千七百項臨床試驗的數據，從而得出結論。這些運動有助於緩解全球超過十七億人所患的肌肉骨骼疾病。其益處包括改善活動能力、提升睡眠品質以及增強骨骼強度。專家建議，應將這些運動納入全球的標準醫療照護體系中。

paragraphs.en: A major new study has confirmed that traditional Chinese exercises, such as Tai Chi, offer important health benefits for people suffering from musculoskeletal conditions. These are health problems that affect the muscles, bones, and joints. According to The Guardian Health, this is the largest review of its kind ever conducted. The research team analyzed data from 92 different studies, which included information from 1,744 clinical trials. The findings were recently published in the British Journal of Sports Medicine.
paragraphs.zh: 一項重大的新研究證實，太極拳等傳統中國運動對患有肌肉骨骼疾病的人群具有顯著的健康益處。這些疾病是指影響肌肉、骨骼與關節的健康問題。根據《衛報健康》（The Guardian Health）報導，這是同類研究中規模最大的一次。研究團隊分析了九十二項不同研究的數據，其中涵蓋了一千七百四十四項臨床試驗的資訊。研究結果近期發表於《英國運動醫學期刊》（British Journal of Sports Medicine）。

paragraphs.en: Musculoskeletal conditions are a global health challenge. The Guardian Health reports that more than 1.7 billion people around the world live with these issues. While these problems are more common as people get older, they can affect people of all ages. These conditions often limit how well a person can move or use their hands. This can lead to serious consequences, such as forcing people to retire from their jobs early or making it difficult for them to participate in daily social activities. In fact, low back pain is currently the leading cause of disability in 160 countries.
paragraphs.zh: 肌肉骨骼疾病是一項全球性的健康挑戰。《衛報健康》指出，全球有超過十七億人飽受這些問題困擾。雖然這些問題隨著年齡增長而更為常見，但各個年齡層的人都可能受到影響。這些疾病往往會限制個人的活動能力或手部功能，進而導致嚴重後果，例如迫使人們提早退休，或使其難以參與日常社交活動。事實上，下背痛目前已成為一百六十個國家中導致失能的首要原因。

paragraphs.en: For a long time, doctors have suspected that traditional Chinese exercises could help, but the previous evidence was often scattered or unclear. This new study provides what researchers call “high certainty evidence.” The exercises studied include Tai Chi, Qigong, Baduanjin, Wuqinxi, and Yijinjing. The study found that these practices are effective for a wide range of health outcomes. For example, Tai Chi was shown to significantly reduce chronic pain and stiffness in the body. It also helped increase bone mineral density, which is very important for people with conditions like osteoporosis, a disease that makes bones weak and easy to break.
paragraphs.zh: 長期以來，醫師們一直懷疑傳統中國運動可能有助於改善健康，但先前的證據往往零散或不明確。這項新研究提供了研究人員所稱的「高度確定性證據」。研究涵蓋的運動包括太極拳、氣功、八段錦、五禽戲與易筋經。研究發現，這些練習對於多種健康指標皆有成效。例如，研究顯示太極拳能顯著減輕慢性疼痛與身體僵硬，並有助於增加骨質密度，這對於患有骨質疏鬆症（一種導致骨骼脆弱且易骨折的疾病）的患者至關重要。

paragraphs.en: Beyond physical movement, the study highlighted improvements in mental health and sleep quality. Researchers noted that Tai Chi helped improve mental health for people suffering from neck pain and knee osteoarthritis. It also helped people with fibromyalgia, a condition that causes widespread body pain, to get better sleep. The researchers concluded that these exercises are a safe, easy-to-access, and low-cost way to help patients manage their own health. By using these exercises, patients might even be able to rely less on medication.
paragraphs.zh: 除了身體活動外，該研究還強調了這些運動在改善心理健康與睡眠品質方面的成效。研究人員指出，太極拳有助於改善頸痛與膝關節炎患者的心理健康。它也能幫助纖維肌痛症（一種導致全身廣泛性疼痛的疾病）患者獲得更好的睡眠。研究人員總結認為，這些運動是一種安全、易於執行且低成本的方式，能協助患者自主管理健康。透過這些運動，患者甚至可能減少對藥物的依賴。

paragraphs.en: To get the best results, the study suggests that people should practice these exercises consistently. The researchers found that the maximum benefits were achieved when people exercised for longer than six months. They recommend doing these activities at least three times a week, for a total of at least 150 minutes every week. This level of activity helps the body adapt and gain the most strength and flexibility from the movements.
paragraphs.zh: 為了達到最佳效果，研究建議人們應持續練習這些運動。研究人員發現，當人們運動超過六個月時，能獲得最大的效益。他們建議每週至少進行三次此類活動，每週總時長至少達到一百五十分鐘。這種運動強度有助於身體適應，並從動作中獲得最大的肌力與柔軟度提升。

paragraphs.en: As the global population grows and people live longer, the number of individuals with musculoskeletal conditions is rising quickly. Because of this, the researchers believe that healthcare systems and government policymakers should take action. They suggest that promoting traditional Chinese exercises in local communities and primary care settings could be a smart strategy for public health. By adding these exercises to standard rehabilitation programs, health systems can help people stay active and healthy as they age.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著全球人口成長與壽命延長，患有肌肉骨骼疾病的人數正迅速增加。因此，研究人員認為醫療體系與政府決策者應採取行動。他們建議在地方社區與基層醫療環境中推廣傳統中國運動，這可能是一項明智的公共衛生策略。透過將這些運動納入標準復健計畫，醫療體系能協助人們在年老時保持活躍與健康。

paragraphs.en: Ultimately, the study serves as a strong recommendation for doctors to include these traditional practices in their treatment plans. The researchers stated that these exercises represent a powerful tool for self-management. By empowering patients to take control of their own physical therapy through movement, healthcare providers can offer a better quality of life to millions. As more evidence supports these methods, it is likely that Tai Chi and similar practices will become a more common part of medical advice around the world.
paragraphs.zh: 最終，這項研究強烈建議醫師將這些傳統練習納入治療計畫中。研究人員表示，這些運動是患者自我管理的強大工具。透過賦予患者自主權，讓他們能藉由運動進行物理治療，醫療照護提供者能為數百萬人帶來更好的生活品質。隨著越來越多證據支持這些方法，太極拳與類似的練習很可能會成為全球醫療建議中更常見的一部分。

keyTerms.definitionEn: Spread over a wide area or occurring at irregular intervals; not organized or gathered together.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作動詞（散開），這裡作形容詞描述證據的狀態。文中：For a long time, doctors have suspected that traditional Chinese exercises could help, but the previous evidence was often scattered or unclear.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To need or depend on something to a smaller degree than before.
keyTerms.noteZh: rely on 是常見片語，這裡加上 less 表示程度的減少。文中：By using these exercises, patients might even be able to rely less on medication.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To do something to solve a problem or deal with a situation.
keyTerms.noteZh: take 常見於具體動作，這裡與 action 搭配為固定用法，表示解決問題。文中：Because of this, the researchers believe that healthcare systems and government policymakers should take action.

quiz.question: According to the study, what is the minimum weekly time commitment recommended to achieve the maximum health benefits?
quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第五段，研究建議每週至少進行三次練習，總時長至少達到 150 分鐘，才能獲得最大的健康效益。選項 A 是錯誤數字；選項 C 的 160 是文章提到低背痛導致失能的國家數量，而非時間；選項 D 的 1,744 則是研究分析中所包含的臨床試驗總數，皆為混淆選項。

quiz.question: Based on the article, why might healthcare systems be interested in promoting traditional Chinese exercises?

options.A: To replace all existing medical treatments with exercise.
options.B: Because these exercises are the only way to cure osteoporosis.
options.C: To reduce the financial and medical burden on the healthcare system.
options.D: To increase the number of people retiring from their jobs early.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章第四段提到這些練習是低成本且易於取得的，且能讓患者減少對藥物的依賴，最後一段更提到這是強大的自我管理工具，能幫助患者保持活躍，這對醫療體系而言能有效減輕負擔。A 選項過於極端，文章僅建議納入治療計畫而非取代；B 選項錯誤，文章僅說有助於骨密度，而非唯一療法；D 選項與文章目標相反，文章旨在避免人們因健康問題過早退休。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the word 'empowering' mean as used in the context of the study?

options.A: Giving patients the tools and confidence to manage their own health.
options.B: Forcing patients to perform physical therapy without medical help.
options.C: Increasing the physical strength of the patients' muscles.
options.D: Requiring patients to attend government-run training sessions.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在文中，empowering 指的是透過提供方法（如太極等運動），讓患者能夠主動掌控自己的復健過程，增強其自主性。B 選項錯誤，因為這並非強制；C 選項雖然運動能增強肌力，但 empowering 在此處是指心理與能力上的賦權，而非單純的肌肉力量；D 選項過度解讀，文章並未要求必須參加政府舉辦的課程。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of the article regarding traditional Chinese exercises?

options.A: They are a new, unproven method for treating muscle pain.
options.B: They should only be practiced by elderly people with bone issues.
options.C: They are a highly effective, low-cost tool that should be integrated into standard medical care.
options.D: They are the leading cause of disability in 160 countries around the world.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。全文的核心在於介紹這項大規模研究，證實了傳統中國運動對肌肉骨骼問題的顯著療效，並建議醫療體系應將其納入常規治療計畫中。A 選項錯誤，研究已證實其有效性；B 選項錯誤，文章提到這些問題影響各年齡層；D 選項混淆了文章資訊，160 個國家是指低背痛導致失能的現況，而非運動的影響。
